description: Source code for network change notification handling on macOS/iOS, including reachability monitoring, network type calculation, and configuration change handling.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac
classes.description: Implements network change notifications for macOS/iOS, including reachability and configuration change handling.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierMac::Forwarder
classes.description: Helper class to forward network configuration change events and manage reachability notifications.

methods.name: CalculateReachability
methods.description: Determines if a network is reachable based on SCNetworkConnectionFlags.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type, waiting up to a timeout if necessary.

methods.name: CalculateConnectionType
methods.description: Calculates network connection type from SCNetworkConnectionFlags, with special handling for iOS.

methods.name: SetInitialConnectionType
methods.description: Initializes the network connection type by checking reachability to 0.0.0.0.

methods.name: StartReachabilityNotifications
methods.description: Sets up reachability callback and schedules notifications on the run loop.

methods.name: SetDynamicStoreNotificationKeys
methods.description: Configures dynamic store keys for network configuration change notifications (iOS and macOS).

methods.name: OnNetworkConfigChange
methods.description: Handles network configuration change events, triggering IP address change notifications.

methods.name: ReachabilityCallback
methods.description: Static callback invoked on network reachability changes, updating connection type and notifying observers.
